faqs.question: How and when do I have to register?
faqs.answer: Members must register once every program year. FY24 program starts 1 Apr 2024 – 31 March 2025 at https://www.nissanelite.com.au/reg2024.

faqs.question: How do I join Nissan ELITE?
faqs.answer: Refer to “Are you eligible?” on the login page. You must be enrolled on the Nissan Dealer User Management portal and hold a 5-digit registration number and be in a Nissan ELITE eligible role. You will be automatically rolled over into Nissan ELITE, receiving a Welcome Pack with your details, and notification for your compulsory registration at https://www.nissanelite.com.au/reg2024. On completion you will receive an e-Mail confirmation and only then be eligible to earn Awards/Rewards within Nissan ELITE.

faqs.question: Am I eligible to participate in Sprint Incentives?
faqs.answer: Yes, providing the criteria is applicable to your role and all ELITE & Sprint Incentive T&Cs are met. Nissan ELITE registration is compulsory for all incentives.

faqs.question: Am I eligible in Nissan ELITE if I am enrolled on the Nissan Dealer User Management portal?
faqs.answer: If you are enrolled on the Nissan Dealer User Management portal in an eligible ELITE role you are a member of ELITE but NOT an eligible member until you have registered in the current program period. Every member must register once in every Nissan ELITE period (current program 1 Apr – 31 March) to be eligible.

faqs.question: What is the Nissan ELITE period?
Where can I find my metrics and criteria for Nissan ELITE?
faqs.answer: Go to the Members Guide tab and click your department/role tab. You will find all information about Nissan ELITE here.

faqs.question: What is the best way to get around the website to learn about ELITE?
faqs.answer: Help is provided in the MEMBER GUIDE tab by selecting the NAVIGATING THE SITE button. Our ELITE Service Team is also available on info@nissanelite.com.au or 03 9544 9054.
